mapper.select:
select date_format(cr.call_time, #{periodFmt}) as period,
cr.agent_id as dim_agent, a.agent_name as dim_agent_name,
ifnull(cr.category_id, -1) as dim_category, c.category_name as dim_category_name,
ifnull(p.language_preference, 'zh-CN') as dim_lang,
count(*) as call_total, sum(case when cr.status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as call_answered, sum(case when cr.status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as call_missed, sum(case when cr.status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as call_transferred, sum(case when cr.status = '1' then ifnull(cr.duration, 0) else 0 end) as answered_duration_sum from ai_call_record cr left join ai_caller_profile p on p.caller_number = cr.caller_number left join ai_call_agent_status a on cr.agent_id = a.agent_id left join ai_consultation_category c on cr.category_id = c.category_id where cr.call_time >= #{beginTime} and cr.call_time < #{endTime} group by period,
cr.agent_id ifnull(cr.category_id, -1) ifnull(p.language_preference, 'zh-CN')
order by period limit #{limitRows}
select agent_id, agent_name from ai_call_agent_status where agent_id in #{id}
select category_id, category_name from ai_consultation_category where category_id in #{id}
